records.title: Construction of Interchange on Varanasi-Kolkata Expressway
details: a to d: Furter, a Vehicular Underpass (VUP) has been proposed at Araju (Barwadih) in Bokaro for crossing of local farmers and emergency medical needs. The entry/ exit through slip road at this location is under examination.

records.title: Construction of elevated road between Sonardih to Gaushala on NH-32
details: c to e: explored in consultation with Ministry of Coal which lies outside the fire zone.

records.title: Development of Talgaria Railway Station as a satellite station
details: लेकिन इन्होंने जिस तरह तालगड़िया का महत्व उस पूरे एरिया में बताया, उसका लाभ निश्चित रूप से रेलवे को मिलेगा। इसमें प्रोजेक्ट्स टीम को ऑलरेडी बोल दिया है कि जल्दी से जाकर सर्वे करे, फील्ड में एस्टीमेट बनाए और कैपेसिटी बढ़ाने के लिए काम करे। झारखंड में चार और ऐसे पॉइंट्स इस प्रश्न के बाद निकले हैं।

records.title: ROBS and Railway underpass project on NH-32
details: c to e: After receipt of the details from DGMS, new alignment for ROBs will be finalised.

records.title: New Train Services from Dhanbad Junction
details: a to c: In addition, it has also been decided to introduce 16619/16620 Podanur-Coimbatore-Dhanbad Amrit Bharat Express.

records.title: CONSTRUCTION OF KENDRIYA VIDHYALAYA IN DHANBAD, JHARKHAND.
details: a to d: Subsequently, the State Government of Jharkhand has proposed an alternate land parcel measuring 4.30 acres, which was accepted by KVS in September, 2023 subject to removal of certain shortcomings such as earth filing, approach road, drinking water supply etc. The said land, free of all discrepancies, is yet to be transferred by State Government of Jharkhand in favour of KVS.

records.title: Doubling of Shivpur - Kathautia Rail Line Project.
details: a to f: Shipur- Kathautia (47 Km) new line project has been sanctioned at a cost of Rs. 1799 Cr and track has been laid on Kathautia- Duari (14 Km) section. Work has been taken up on balance section.
